info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Nosean Drill Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Nosean Drill Detail Catalog API facilitates the submission of detailed information related to Nosean drills into the catalog. This API allows users to create entries that include specifications, configurations, and other relevant attributes of the Nosean drills. Typical consumers include product managers and engineers responsible for cataloging drill specifications in a centralized database. By using this API, organizations can ensure accurate and consistent tracking of drill details for inventory and operational purposes.

post.summary: Create a new Nosean Drill detail.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new detail related to a Nosean Drill, providing essential data for further processing and analysis. Ensure that all required fields are included in the request body to avoid errors.

requestBody.description: Request body to provide detailed operational information for the Nosean drill. This should include all necessary parameters and data structures as defined in the schema.

200.description: The request was successful, and the response contains the requested details.

CreateCatalogNoseanDrillDetailRequest.title: Nosean Drill Request Body

nosean_drill_id.description: The unique identifier for the Nosean drill.

requestedBy.description: The name or identifier of the person requesting the drill operation.

quantity.description: The number of drills being requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the drill request is of high priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the drill operation.

tags.description: A list of tags associated with the drill request for categorization.

items.description: A single tag related to the drill request.
